get_autocast_amp: get the autocast context manager for standard AMP float16 precision training
get_autocast_bfloat16: get the autocast context manager for bfloat16 precision which is more stable for CLIP training
get_autocast_suppress: get the suppress context manager when no precision mode is specified
review_get_autocast: review the get_autocast function to understand how it maps precision strings to context managers
refactor_get_autocast: refactor get_autocast to support additional precision modes beyond amp and bfloat16
